name: 24 Hours in A&E
description: A British medical documentary set in King's College Hospital. 91 cameras filmed round the clock for 28 days, 24 hours a day in A&E it offers unprecedented access to one of Britain's busiest A&E departments.

videos.title: The Making of 24 Hours in A&E
videos.overview: 24 Hours in A&E is one of Channel 4's groundbreaking and critically acclaimed programmes. This documentary takes a look behind the scenes at how this large-scale production is made through every stage of the process. It asks why King's College Hospital allowed the cameras in, what impact the series has had on the hospital staff, and why the public agree to be filmed. Unlike most documentaries, the series captures life in the Emergency Department using what's called a 'fixed rig'. This programme captures the rig being set up, as 92 remotely-operated cameras, 100 microphones and 16 miles of wiring are installed in the department by technicians. The programme shows how the crew of 170 - an unprecedented number for a documentary - is assembled and trained. The team work on site for six weeks of non-stop round-the-clock filming, handling 8000 hours of footage to make 28 episodes of the series, which is broadcast in 54 countries.

videos.title: 24 Hours in A&E for Stand Up To Cancer
videos.overview: A woman with a weak immune system owing to the radiotherapy she underwent for breast cancer is bitten by her cat, a minor injury that could cause her serious problems. A 72-year-old with terminal cancer is brought in with breathing difficulties and a decision must be made about whether to resuscitate her if her condition worsens. Meanwhile, a 13-year-old translates for his Brazilian grandmother and a six-year-old has her head wound stitched.

videos.title: The Last Roll Of The Dice
videos.overview: Roofer Simon is critically injured from a two-storey fall onto concrete. 97-year-old Doris is in resus with a fast heart rate. Evelyn has burnt her finger on a cheese stick.

videos.title: The Ultimate Price
videos.overview: Pro-bike-rider Max has hit his head in a high-speed crash. A man arrives at A&E with two of his severed fingers in a bag of frozen peas after having a wood-chopping accident.

videos.title: Picking Up The Pieces
videos.overview: Jeremy and Patricia are rushed to Queen's Medical Centre in Nottingham with multiple injuries after a high-speed car crash. Andrew has fallen three metres from a ladder at work.

videos.title: Bless The Child
videos.overview: A little boy has a stone up his nose from playing football. A 92-year-old got trapped under her car. World War II hero Norman, who is 95, has a dangerously low heart rate.

videos.title: Where We Belong
videos.overview: Andy, 36, has had a motorbike accident. Adrian has injuries to his face and has been bitten on his arm while breaking up a fight in the city centre. Connor has fallen 12 feet off a roof.

videos.title: Sunny Side Up
videos.overview: At Queen's Medical Centre in Nottingham, a patient is rushed to Resus with multiple stab wounds to his chest and back. Also in Resus, 87-year-old Eunice is coughing up large amounts of blood, while 15-year-old Tyler is in A&E with his mum Claire after injuring his foot playing football.

videos.title: Without Warning
videos.overview: In Nottingham, David's collapsed at home with a suspected stroke. Cecil's in A&E after his motorbike crashed at 130mph. Tanya's had a possible seizure on a night out.

videos.title: After The Storm
videos.overview: Decorator Philip has fallen 12 feet from a ladder. Liam flew off the back of a motorbike at high speed. Three-year-old Jonah has injured his elbow while playing with his mum.

videos.title: Hanging On
videos.overview: Eleven-year-old William has been hit by a car and thrown 30 feet; 68-year-old Stephen is struggling to breathe; and Ryan has broken his arm at rugby.

videos.title: Unbroken Ties
videos.overview: A ten-week-old baby has choked on his milk at home. Fiftysomething Tony has a flesh-eating leg infection. And is the bruising on Gerald’s leg more serious than he realises?

videos.title: Finding Your Way Back
videos.overview: A 19-year-old man is rushed to Queen's Medical Centre after his motorbike crashed into the back of a car.

videos.title: The Strength Within
videos.overview: A 23-year-old woman is rushed into A&E after falling off a horse, which then rolled on top of her. Doctors worry that she may have major organ damage and internal bleeding.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A young woman has inexplicably collapsed while she was out running. At Queen's, the A&E doctors play detective to figure out why she collapsed.
